review:
The fishing formula on Megaways reels, so the ways change every spin. Three, four, five or six scatters give 10, 15, 20 or 25 free spins.

In the bonus, fishermen collect every money fish that lands with them – worth up to 4,000x each – and every fourth fisherman adds 10 spins and a 2x, then 3x, then 10x multiplier. More ways and bigger fish than the original, with a 96.7% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
